prompt: In the style of an oil painting, a busy airport gate scene unfolds with rich textures and deep shadows. On the left, a woman in a yellow coat stands holding a boarding pass, her posture upright and alert as she looks at a digital screen mounted on the wall. Next to her sits a large black suitcase, its wheels slightly worn from travel. In the center, a man in a blue suit sits on a metal bench, his head tilted back in exhaustion, while a small child in a green shirt climbs onto his lap, reaching for a toy airplane. The man gently holds the child's hand to steady them. To the right of the bench, a brown dog lies on the floor, its tail curled around its paws, resting peacefully amidst the chaos. A flight attendant in a navy uniform stands near the dog, pointing toward the open gate door where passengers are beginning to queue. Behind the attendant, a pilot in a white hat walks briskly past, carrying a leather briefcase. Near the window on the far right, an elderly man in a gray sweater leans against the glass, watching the tarmac where a silver plane is visible in the distance. A coffee cup sits abandoned on a nearby table, steam no longer rising from it. There is no snow visible outside the window, despite the winter coats worn by many travelers. There is no electronic billboard displaying advertisements, only the essential flight information screens. The scene captures the transient nature of travel through the distinct appearances and quiet interactions of these ten entities.
